name: small-business-library
description: Search what the Small Business Owners Community has learned about running a small business. Every answer carries its source, date, and link.

interface.longDescription:
Six years of what small business owners have learned the hard way, in one place your AI can search.

The Small Business Library holds the Small Business Help blog and past episodes of Businessing with Pat Miller, the daily show where owners bring their real questions. Ask about what to charge, raising your rates, getting clients, late payers, hiring, working too many hours, marketing, or using AI in your business. ChatGPT pulls the best matching passages and tells you where each one came from, with the title, the date, and a link to read the full post or watch the episode.

There's nothing to log in to. It only reads, and it never changes anything.

Presented by the Small Business Owners Community, a community for small business owners, solopreneurs through teams of about 25.

This is general business information and education, not legal, tax, or financial advice.
defaultPrompt: How do I raise my prices without losing clients?
I'm working way too many hours. Where do I start?
A client keeps paying late. What should I do?
